prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and grab object. If visible, approach. If not, scan area. Take to location. Put down if heavy. Perform specific task.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = PutObjectDown    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToLocation
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO PutObjectDown
	END
